steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Initialize app name as 'Photo Resizer Pro' and package name as 'com.photoresizerpro.app' to ensure consistency across the project.

steps.title: Review settings.gradle
steps.description: Verify settings.gradle declares correct module configurations for Gradle 8.5 compatibility.

steps.title: Setup root-level build.gradle
steps.description: Define build configurations and dependency repositories like Google and Maven Central with Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2.

steps.title: Configure module build.gradle
steps.description: Set compiler and target SDK versions to 34, set Java 8 source and target compatibility, and declare system libraries.

steps.title: Review App Manifest
steps.description: Validate AndroidManifest.xml package names, activities, and layout orientation permissions inside a safe namespace structure.

steps.title: Define UI Background Drawables
steps.description: Establish drawables for card backgrounds, buttons, and input styles under the app resources folder.

steps.title: Translate and Re-engineer Layout
steps.description: Re-architect activity_main.xml to translate all Hindi components to English. Integrate design configurations for passport size and signature size preset actions.

steps.title: Implement Startup Loader and Sound Manager
steps.description: Develop automated startup loading progress animations inside MainActivity.java. Implement sound synthesis using native ToneGenerator for clicks and process milestones.

steps.title: Integrate Document Presets and Dialog Interactivity
steps.description: Configure click handlers for passport dimensions (350x450 px) and signature dimensions (300x100 px). Embed standard alert validation prompts before resizing and following image exports.

steps.title: Building Photo Resizer Pro
steps.description: Execute standard debugging compile pipelines to construct the final compiled stable APK.
